Experimental advanced functional trajectory methods in native R

advanced-phase3.Rd

Selective experimental R implementations for univariate sparse PACE through the optional fdapace R package, descriptive multilevel FPCA, participant-cluster bootstrap functional mean bands, discrete transfer entropy, and independent known-truth simulation and workflows.

Usage

etr_sparse_curves(times, values, curve_ids = NULL, time_unit = "unknown")

etr_fit_sparse_pace(x, max_components = 3L, fve = 0.95, options = list())

etr_sparse_pace_scores(fit)

etr_sparse_pace_fitted(fit)

etr_fit_multilevel_fpca(x, participant, n_between = 2L, n_within = 2L)

etr_multilevel_scores(fit)

etr_multilevel_variance(fit)

etr_bootstrap_mean_band(x, participant, B = 399L, alpha = 0.05, seed = 1L)

etr_simulate_hierarchical(n_subjects = 20L, trials_per_subject = 3L, n_time = 41L,
    subject_sd = 0.35, trial_sd = 0.15, noise_sd = 0.05, seed = 7L)

etr_evaluate_mean_band_coverage(simulations = 20L, B = 99L, alpha = 0.10,
    n_subjects = 20L, seed = 100L)

etr_transfer_entropy(source, target, k_target = 1L, k_source = 1L, lag = 1L,
    conditioning = NULL)

etr_transfer_entropy_shift_test(source, target, k_target = 1L, k_source = 1L,
    lag = 1L, conditioning = NULL, n_surrogates = 99L, seed = 1L)

etr_transfer_entropy_directions(source, target, k_target = 1L, k_source = 1L,
    lag = 1L)

etr_simulate_sparse_known_truth(n_subjects = 45L, min_observations = 5L,
    max_observations = 10L, noise_sd = 0.10, score_sd = 0.60, seed = 22L)

etr_evaluate_sparse_pace_recovery(simulations = 5L, n_subjects = 45L, seed = 100L,
    max_components = 2L)

etr_evaluate_multilevel_recovery(simulations = 10L, n_subjects = 20L, seed = 200L)

etr_run_sparse_pace_workflow(x, max_components = 3L, fve = 0.95, options = list())

etr_run_multilevel_workflow(x, participant, n_between = 2L, n_within = 2L)

etr_run_mean_band_workflow(x, participant, B = 399L, alpha = 0.05, seed = 1L)

etr_run_transfer_entropy_workflow(source, target, k_target = 1L, k_source = 1L,
    lag = 1L, conditioning = NULL, n_surrogates = 99L, seed = 1L)

Arguments

times

A list of strictly increasing, finite observation-time vectors.

values

A matching list of complete numeric observation vectors.

curve_ids

Optional unique curve identifiers.

time_unit

Declared observation time unit.

x

A native trajectory collection, or a sparse collection for PACE.

max_components

Maximum positive integer number of sparse components.

fve

Fraction-of-variance threshold in (0,1].

options

Optional named fdapace options; required design settings are locked.

fit

A native advanced fit object of the appropriate class.

participant

Participant labels per curve, or a metadata column name.

n_between

Retained between-participant FPCA component count.

n_within

Retained within-participant FPCA component count.

B

Number of cluster bootstrap draws, at least 39.

alpha

Target miscoverage level strictly in (0,1); calibration is not established.

seed

Integer random seed. The global R random state is restored.

n_subjects

Number of independent subjects.

trials_per_subject

Repeated trials per subject.

n_time

Common-grid time points in the synthetic generator.

subject_sd

Standard deviation of participant effects.

trial_sd

Standard deviation of trial-specific effects.

noise_sd

Independent observation-noise standard deviation.

simulations

Number of independently generated Monte Carlo datasets.

source

Pre-discretized driving-state vector.

target

Pre-discretized receiving-state vector of the same length.

k_target

Number of historical target states.

k_source

Number of historical source states.

lag

Declared source delay in samples, at least 1.

conditioning

Optional aligned discretized conditioning-state vector.

n_surrogates

Number of circular-shift surrogate realizations.

min_observations

Minimum observed samples in each simulated sparse curve.

max_observations

Maximum observed samples in each simulated sparse curve.

score_sd

Standard deviation of latent functional scores.

Details

These functions are experimental and not independently qualified. The sparse PACE estimator delegates to fdapace; the native R package does not reimplement the PACE smoother. The two-level FPCA separates participant means from within-participant residuals and is descriptive, not a REML functional mixed-effects model.

The cluster mean-band resampling unit is the independent participant. The max-studentized simultaneous band has no demonstrated nominal coverage under general designs. The transfer-entropy estimator uses plug-in discrete conditional mutual information; circular-shift results are descriptive and do not establish causal direction or universally valid randomization p-values. All synthetic methods use known-truth data distinct from the estimator implementation.

The methods are documented further in docs/phase3-scientific-qualification.md.

Value

Depending on the function, an etr_sparse_curves or etr_sparse_pace object, a two-level etr_multilevel_fpca object, an etr_mean_band object, a list of transfer-entropy estimates and diagnostics, an independent simulation result, or an auditable etr_advanced_workflow object.

See also

etr_fit_fpca, etr_trajectory_set

Examples

sample <- etr_simulate_hierarchical(
  n_subjects = 8L, trials_per_subject = 2L, n_time = 9L, seed = 5L
)
band <- etr_bootstrap_mean_band(
  sample$trajectories, sample$participant,
  B = 39L, alpha = 0.10, seed = 7L
)
stopifnot(identical(dim(band$mean), c(9L, 2L)))
# This illustrates API behavior, not calibrated interval coverage.
